home.text_001: Guiding You to Knowledge and Values
home.text_002: Develop your knowledge and strengthen your values. Explore resources, guidance, and opportunities for personal and professional growth.
home.text_007: Expert Guidance for Your Educational Journey
home.text_008: We are here with guidance services to help you find the right direction in education. Get support from experienced educators and experts.
home.text_010: Facilitate your educational process with comprehensive resources and tools designed for students and teachers. Suitable content for every level is at your fingertips.
home.text_012: Discover seminars, guidance services, and personal development opportunities tailored to your educational journey.

home.text_043: Your people. Your time. Your Wapa.
home.text_045: At Line Education, we empower individuals of all ages to enhance their personal and professional development. Whether you're looking to access valuable resources, connect with knowledgeable and experienced mentors, or benefit from their insights and materials, we are here to guide you. Our focus on character education ensures that you not only gain knowledge but also develop essential values that enrich your life and community. Let us be your partner in building a brighter future.
home.text_047: Access knowledge with confidence through materials prepared by experienced and expert educators.
home.text_049: Get closer to success by accessing personalized educational opportunities, the right mentors, and effective methods.
home.text_051: We aim to maximize individuals' potential by adding value to knowledge through character education.
home.text_065: A learner and educator discussing questions about learning
home.text_067: What programs does Line Education offer?
home.text_068: Our programs cover professional development, student guidance, parent education seminars, language learning, reading, educational consultancy, summer camps, and education leadership and management.
home.text_069: Who are the educational resources for?
home.text_070: We provide educational resources and guidance for students and teachers, together with education seminars for parents.
home.text_072: Explore Moral Education for character education, Ilimpia for learning through language, Linooks for reading, and WAPA for workforce, attendance, and payroll automation. Each service card links to its website.
home.text_073: How can I ask about a program?
home.text_074: Use the email or WhatsApp links on this page to ask Line Education about the program that interests you.
home.text_076: Advance Through Knowledge, Elevate Through Virtues!

privacy.about_body: Line Education is an informational website about educational programs and services. It does not offer an on-site contact form, user accounts or payment collection. We have not installed advertising trackers or visitor analytics on this website.
privacy.contact_body: If you contact Line Education by email, phone or WhatsApp, we receive the contact details and message content you choose to provide. We use that information to respond to your inquiry and discuss the information or support you request. Please share only what is needed for your question and avoid sending sensitive personal information unnecessarily.
privacy.description: How the Line Education website uses language preferences, technical request information and information you choose to send when contacting us.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how "Line" LLC (ОсОО «Лайн»), the operator of the Line Education website, handles information involved when you browse this site or contact us using its links.
privacy.language_body: We save your selected language (English or Kyrgyz) in your browser’s local storage under the key linekg.language. This allows the website to remember your choice. The entry contains only the language code, en or ky, and remains until you clear the website’s stored data. Page addresses also include the selected language, so the hosting server receives that choice when you request a page. We do not use this preference for advertising or visitor profiling. You can change the language using the EN/KY buttons or remove the preference in your browser settings.
privacy.operator: Website operator and contact for privacy matters: "Line" LLC (ОсОО «Лайн»). You can contact us at linekginfo@gmail.com.
privacy.providers_body: Email, telephone and WhatsApp links open services outside this website. Gmail, WhatsApp and your telephone provider handle information according to their own policies. Our service cards also link to separate websites with their own privacy practices. Review the relevant provider’s policy when using those services.
privacy.requests_body: For questions about this policy or requests concerning information you have sent to "Line" LLC (ОсОО «Лайн»), contact us at the email address below. Tell us which communication your request concerns. We will consider your request in light of the information we hold, the services used and applicable requirements.
privacy.technical_body: To deliver the website, the hosting server receives requests from your browser. Depending on its configuration, the hosting provider may process information such as your IP address, browser details, requested page and request time for delivery, security and troubleshooting. Storage and retention depend on the hosting service and its configuration; this policy does not specify a fixed retention period for server logs.
privacy.updates_body: We will update this page when the website’s information practices change. The date above indicates the latest update.
